offers_products.reason: Revenue is asset management fees from investment management; investment strategies/funds are financial services, not goods or software.

offers_services.reason: Affiliates provide investment management services; AMG also provides distribution and strategic support, as a global asset manager.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Wealth platform gives financial advisors' clients and individual investors access to funds, alongside institutional clients.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Global institutional distribution serves pension funds and institutional investors; it also partners with independent investment firms.

recurring_revenue.reason: Management fees on ongoing client assets under management recur; performance fees are a smaller part.

cyclical_demand.reason: Fees depend on asset values and flows, which fall in downturns; clients can redeem or reallocate.

big_ticket.reason: Clients pay ongoing percentage fees on assets, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Investment management is delivered through portfolio managers' skill at Affiliate firms; staff are the main value.

large_customers.reason: Mix of institutions and wealth clients via advisors; households and individuals are significant, so not mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light investment manager and holding company; needs people and offices, not plants or fleets.

notes: AMG is a holding company with minority stakes in investment firms; buyer mix between institutional and wealth is not quantified.
